# Vendored doctest

Single-header copy of the doctest C++ testing framework.

- Upstream: https://github.com/doctest/doctest
- Version: v2.5.2 (release tag), `doctest.h` taken verbatim from that tag
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE.txt` in this directory
- Copyright (c) 2016-2023 Viktor Kirilov

Do not edit `doctest.h` by hand. To upgrade, replace `doctest.h` and
`LICENSE.txt` with the files from a newer upstream release tag and update the
version recorded here.
